name: comms
description: Comms. Writing in your voice. /setup-voice captures how you write once, into the shared voice file every plugin reads; /style drafts an email, message, post, or document in that voice; /style-review compares a draft with what you finally sent; /style-learn proposes a style-rule update only after the same edit recurs; /post assembles the weekly roundup post from research's staged candidates. Drafts only: it never sends or publishes.
